kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مُدَاوٍ • (mudāwin) (informal مُدَاوِي (mudāwī), feminine مُدَاوِيَة (mudāwiya), masculine plural مُدَاوُون (mudāwūn), feminine plural مُدَاوِيَات (mudāwiyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Derived from the active participle of دَاوَى (dāwā, “to treat”).
g: one who treats or cures (a medical problem)
